# Fresh installs explain sign-in, save credentials, and resume the command.
env HOME=$HOME/onboarding
env NLM_TEST_INTERACTIVE=0
env 'NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=fail:browser must not open'
! exec ./nlm_test ls
! stdout .
stderr '\Anlm: authentication required; run `nlm auth` in a terminal \(or set NLM_AUTH_TOKEN and NLM_COOKIES\)\nnlm: exit-class=auth \(exit 3\)\n\z'

# Argument errors and help must not start onboarding.
env NLM_TEST_INTERACTIVE=1
! exec ./nlm_test ls --unknown
! stderr 'welcome|login failed'
exec ./nlm_test ls --help
! stderr 'welcome|login failed|deprecated'

# Successful login resumes the requested command and persists the session.
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=ok
env NLM_TEST_COMMAND_RESULTS=ok:notebook-result
exec ./nlm_test ls
stdout '\Anotebook-result\n\z'
stderr '\Anlm: welcome! Sign in to NotebookLM in the browser; this command will continue automatically\.\nnlm: authenticating via browser \(profile nlm\)\.\.\.\nnlm: credentials written to ~/\.nlm/env\n\z'
exists $HOME/.nlm/env

# Next invocation uses the saved session without another login.
env 'NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=fail:browser must not open'
exec ./nlm_test ls
stdout '\Anotebook-result\n\z'
! stderr .

# Failed first login prints a cause and exits without running the command.
env HOME=$HOME/failed
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=fail:could-not-login
! exec ./nlm_test ls
! stdout .
stderr 'login failed'
stderr 'exit-class=auth-failed \(exit 9\)'

# A rejected new session must not open another browser.
env NLM_TEST_BROWSER_AUTH=ok
env NLM_TEST_COMMAND_RESULTS=401
! exec ./nlm_test ls
! stdout .
! stderr 'session expired, re-authenticating'
